whyUs.heading: Choose pest control around your home’s actual conditions
whyUs.intro: A damp lanai, a kitchen infestation and termite activity need different approaches. Use these local guides to prepare a focused conversation with a provider.

points.title: Rain and exterior entry points
points.text: After storms, check door sweeps, screen gaps, drainage and mulch touching the house. Ask how the proposed treatment addresses both entry points and pest habitat.

points.title: Termite identification and inspection
points.text: Mud tubes, shed wings and damaged wood deserve a professional inspection. Ask which termite species is suspected and whether monitoring, bait or another treatment fits the property.

points.title: Vacation rental scheduling
points.text: Explain check-in dates and any guest reports when requesting a quote. Confirm preparation, treatment time and re-entry instructions before scheduling work.

points.title: A plan you can compare
points.text: Request the inspection findings, expected follow-up, total price and exclusions in writing. Verify the provider’s relevant licensing and insurance before authorizing treatment.

howItWorks.detail: Submit your city, contact details and what you are seeing. Photos, dates and affected rooms can help a provider assess the issue.
A submitted request is an inquiry, not a confirmed appointment. Coverage and response times depend on provider availability.
Confirm the provider’s identity, credentials, inspection terms, price, preparation and treatment scope directly before booking.
Ask about monitoring, repeat visits and any warranty. Those terms come from the provider and are not guaranteed by this website.

globalFaqs.q: Does Orlando Pest Pros perform pest control?
globalFaqs.a: No. Orlando Pest Pros provides pest information and collects quote requests. Any inspection, treatment, pricing or service agreement is handled by the provider you choose.

globalFaqs.q: How much does pest control cost?
globalFaqs.a: Cost depends on the pest, property size, infestation and treatment plan. Request a written estimate and ask whether inspections, repeat visits or recurring service have separate charges.

globalFaqs.q: Is treatment safe around children and pets?
globalFaqs.a: Discuss children, pets, aquariums and sensitive areas with your provider. Follow the product label and the provider’s preparation and re-entry instructions; no treatment is universally risk-free.

globalFaqs.q: Can I get a same-day appointment?
globalFaqs.a: Appointment times depend on the provider’s coverage and schedule. Include any urgency in your request, but submission does not guarantee a same-day appointment.
Return-visit policies and warranties vary by provider. Ask for the covered pests, exclusions, duration and fees in writing before booking.

globalFaqs.q: Do I need a business address to request help?
globalFaqs.a: No storefront address is needed. Provide your city and enough property details to discuss coverage. Arrange any necessary inspection address directly with the provider.

globalFaqs.q: Can I request help for a vacation rental?
globalFaqs.a: Yes. Include your rental’s city, the pest issue and relevant check-in or checkout dates. Confirm scheduling and any guest preparation or re-entry instructions with the provider.
